body.x: MARVRUS will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 andwill display its communication improving solution SPEAKIT in CES startup zoneEureka Park MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT with the support from Changwon IndustryPromotion Agency.

MARVRUS is a edutech company based on realistic content and emotional AI. The company is made up of team members who want to bridge the education gap through technology and provide a marvelous experience. MARVRUS's first B2C service SPEAKIT is a communication enhancement solution which the English speaking education section was awarded the grand prize at the G-valley Entrepreneurship Competition from MOTIE for its trust and quality from partners like public institutions and large corporations. The company also won the grand prize at the e-learning excellent company contest. In April 2019, the company released 5G edutech content, and in November 2019, it officially launched Oculus Pack with SKT.

The solution that combines realistic content and emotional AI technology is what sets MARVRUS apart. SPEAKIT provides a learning environment based on video taken in real life, unlike phone English and video English, where one or several people have to talk in limited situations. In addition, the AI dialogue system provides evaluations such as 'the most frequently answer', 'the most common answer by native speakers', and 'the most frequent wrong answers' in each situation after analyzing the user data during correct answer processing and feedback. In addition, it provides imitation learning that can follow native expressions most quickly and effectively. In addition to measuring voice data, the company have developed a technology to measure emotional data, which is a non-verbal element of users. It can be learned and managed through mobile and tablet, and it provides the fastest way to speak English like a native speaker by conducting unconsciousness tests in over 100 situations through VR.

The official said, “In the case of SPEAKIT English speaking speech education, we are expanding the service to K-12 (kindergarten to high school courses) and infants following the adult market target that was previously launched. And, we are performing contents and technology advancement work. In addition, we will produce and develop various communication education solutions such as job and speech education solutions, Chinese and Korean language education.”

AVING NEWS, the media that has made themost promotion of Korean companies, has set up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT in CES2020 Startup Zone EUREKA PARK as the project to help Korean startups to enterthe global market, and will introduce the major Korean startups to the world.

By using the strengths of CES, AVING NEWS plans to inform investors, buyers and media Korea’s promising startups through various programs such as strategic consulting, PR marketing, and networking parties.

MIK Zone is hosted by Next Generation Convergence Contents Industry Association, AVING NEWS, and MD Insight, and organized by Bluefoot. It is participated by Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, Incheon Techno Park Startup Support Center, Gwangju University Startup Support Group, and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group.
